author: Yffe
content:
Failing tests at forge/tests/divergence_vacuity.rs::{divergence_ens_implied_by_req_over_rejects_partial_implication, divergence_redundant_true_clause_with_real_clause_not_c_rejected} demonstrate the divergence.

ROOT CAUSE: `ens_implied_by_req` in forge/src/vacuity.rs returns `Some(idx)` on the FIRST ens clause that equals req or a req conjunct — i.e. it rejects when ANY clause is implied. The governing authority requires the WHOLE postcondition conjunction be implied.

AUTHORITY: .design/forge/vacuity-triage.md REQ-3 — '(c) reject ... defined as: EVERY ens clause's Clause.expr is structurally identical (PartialEq) to ... the whole req ... or one of the conjuncts of req'. thermite-design.md §7.1 — 'ens is syntactically implied by req alone -> reject' (the whole ens). OQ-4 confirms 'ens true + ens result == x ... carries a real conjunct'.

INPUT 1: req x > 0 && x < 10 / ens x > 0 / ens result == x  (fx pure, non-slag).
INPUT 2: req true / ens true / ens result == x.
EXPECTED: NOT an EnsImpliedByReq reject (result == x is a real obligation not implied by req; the whole ens is non-vacuous -> proceed to L3).
ACTUAL: cert.reject.cause == 'EnsImpliedByReq' (level L0) — the legitimately-stronger contract is wrongly rejected.

The fix narrows the (c) predicate to fire only when EVERY ens clause is req-implied. Control test ens_fully_implied_by_req_still_rejects_c (sole implied clause -> genuine (c) reject) guards against regressing the true-positive (oracle ens_conjunct_req). Tests must go green WITHOUT #[ignore] (R-DEFER-3).
